override.reason: Automated code review is unavailable project-wide (insrc_code_review_step is a stub that always errors while being rewritten; the BUILD record can never show a CR-* sibling, so insrc_present reports it notPending -- same structural wall as Story s1). Substitute: 5 rounds of controller self-review via a packet at /tmp/.insrc/review-packet-639cd2159a87aedb-s2.md, each round investigated against real source and fixed -- output-mode descriptor mismatch (t6), substring false-positive in completion matching, caller-cancellation cache poisoning, config-echo-only denial proof, transient-exhaustion caching, relative-PATH/cwd resolution, and the denial-wording cache-key/validation/short-circuit gaps. Two disclosed, user-confirmed structural Task gaps: t4 (non-self-triggering readOnly field, deferred to avoid a proven regression) and t7 (HLD amendment filed via Story s6's own design.story workflow, not s2's, since a Build Task cannot trigger the amendment pipeline directly). One disclosed, standing limitation: read-only qualification's structural-denial check requires an operator-configured, live-confirmed INSRC_VIBE_ENABLED_TOOLS_DENIAL_WORDING; with nothing configured it correctly stays unavailable by design, not a defect. User reviewed this summary and the packet across all 5 rounds and said "review passed, build approved" in chat.

body.summary: Epic impact: covers Story s1 -- s1 built and landed sc1/sc2 matching their HLD interfaceSketches exactly. This Task is non-code: it files the HLD amendment proposal for sc3's provenAgainst field rename as a tracked artifact. A first attempt (via s6's own round-2 design.story round) used the wrong amendment type (sharedContract.rename, which renames a shared CONTRACT's own display name, not a field inside its interfaceSketch) and was silently dropped by the orchestrator's dry-run against the applier (caught in a try/catch that logs a warning and continues past a bad proposal rather than failing the LLD) -- confirmed by direct listing of .insrc/artifacts/AMD-* showing nothing was ever written, despite the step having been accepted into the LLD body. Direct re-read of src/workflow/amendments/types.ts and applier.ts identified the correct type: sharedContract.fieldRemove (contractId 'sc3', fieldName 'provenAgainst', breaking: true, migrationCue naming the replacement shape and citing s2's LLD section 4.1). Re-ran s6's design.story a third round with this corrected amendment, synthesized, and the user approved it. Directly verified afterward: .insrc/artifacts/AMD-639cd2159a87aedb-1.json now exists on disk, containing the correctly-typed sharedContract.fieldRemove amendment with its rationale citing both s2's LLD section 4.1 and s6's own reconciliation work -- this is the tracked artifact the Task's acceptance checks require. Committed and pushed (commit 5ab9b4709, carrying the Insrc-Story trailer). Left out: the amendment itself is not yet separately approved/rejected (it is 'draft'/pending in its own lifecycle) -- the Task's acceptance checks require it be FILED as a tracked artifact, not that its own approval decision be made; that is a separate governance act outside this Task's scope.
